properties.name: easygram.messaging.type
properties.description: Role of this bot in broker integration: PRODUCER (publish updates) or CONSUMER (receive updates from broker). Omit entirely for standalone bots.

properties.name: easygram.messaging.forward-only
properties.description: When true, updates are published to the broker only; local handlers are skipped. Only meaningful for messaging.type=PRODUCER.

properties.name: easygram.messaging.producer.type
properties.description: Broker backend for publishing updates. Required when messaging.type=PRODUCER.

properties.name: easygram.messaging.consumer.type
properties.description: Broker backend for consuming updates. Required when messaging.type=CONSUMER.

values.description: Receive updates via an HTTPS webhook endpoint.
Publish Telegram updates to a message broker.
Consume updates from a message broker (no direct Telegram transport started).
